\documentclass[a4paper, 10pt]{article}
% Every book is an edition, built with `make [EDITION=<name>]` (tools/build_edition.py).
% The build defines \zpgenerated, the directory of the edition's generated files,
% before this file is read.
\ifdefined\zpgenerated\else
  \errmessage{zpevnik.tex is built per edition: run make [EDITION=<name>]}
  \expandafter\stop
\fi
\usepackage{zpevnik}
% The facts the shared pages print, and the pages of the edition.
\input{\zpgenerated/macros}
\input{\zpgenerated/pages}

\author{\zpbookauthor}
% An empty page: the backs of the cover and of the halftitle.
\newcommand{\blankpage}{\clearpage\mbox{}\clearpage}

% \includeonly{songs/zelviblues, shared-pages/contents}

\begin{document}
\pagestyle{empty}
% Czech book order (D-143): the title page is a right-hand page, the imprint on its back.
\zpcoverpage
\blankpage
\zphalftitlepage
\blankpage
\zptitlepage
\include{shared-pages/imprint}
\zpbeforesongs

\clearpage
\pagestyle{plain}

\begin{Large}
\input{\zpgenerated/include}
\end{Large}
\include{shared-pages/contents}
\zpaftercontents
\end{document}
